---
name: bug report
about: a .mmf that plays wrong, or the player misbehaving
labels: bug
---

**the file**
attach the `.mmf` or a link. the format has corners that only show up on real
tunes, so the file is worth more than a description.

**variant** (if known)
- [ ] HandyPhone (MA-1/2)
- [ ] Mobile (MA-3/5)
- [ ] huffman-packed
- [ ] pcm-heavy (drum kit / sampled tone)
- [ ] not sure

**symptom**
- [ ] rejected as "not a valid SMAF file"
- [ ] parses but silent
- [ ] plays but wrong (notes, tempo, timbre, stuck note)
- [ ] crash or hang
- [ ] other

**what you expected**
e.g. how it sounded on the original handset, or in another player.

**build**
compiler + os, and whether you built the example CLI or linked the library.
